newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London hold firm after weakness.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London hold firm after weakness.

text.p: Japanese shares held firm in London on Monday after weaknes overnight in Tokyo on reports there could be further hikes in consumption tax in Japan, traders said.

"The market (in Japan) overreacted anyway, partly because tomorrow is the last day for fiscal year-end closing...so there was some year-end selling and that was why the market reacted so sharply," one trader said.
"The market in London was very firm and it would certainly suggest we'll see a bounce tomorrow in Tokyo," the trader said.
London's Nikkei/Ise 50 share index finished 21.97 points lower at 1,422.88.
The market was quiet overall but traders said people were particularly looking at some of the high-quality blue-chip stocks and bank issues.
"The fall overnight was quite overdone. Some of the closings are definitely too low and we've seen buyers on the back of that," another trader said.
The Nikkei-225 index finished down 589.34 points or 3.16 percent to 18,043.82.
